profile_description: Advanced baseline: direct-command filter and basic scorer hardening, but no semantic scoring-boundary defense.

relevant_experience.evidence: The candidate has 3 years of experience as a Software Developer at Literacysoft and 2 years as a Technician II at PPG. The work experience is relevant to the software development role.

technical_skills_match.evidence: The candidate has skills in database management, mobile app development, programming languages (PHP, Javascript, Python, Java, C#), operating systems (MacOS X, Linux, Ubuntu, Debian, Raspbian), web development (HTML 5, CSS, Jquery, Ngnix), virtualization (Virtualization, Vmware), containerization (Docker), game development (Unity 3D), and scripting languages (Bash, ECMAScript, Adobe AIR). The skills match the requirements of a standard Software Developer role.

evidence_quality_impact.evidence: The candidate has specific responsibilities described in their work experience, such as developing software applications and improving paint color formulation. However, the evidence is not especially deep or impactful.
